e.body:
**InsuranceOracle** 是**官方 MCP registry**（`registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`）上的一条条目（`io.tooloracle/insuranceoracle`，**v1.0.0，2026-05-07 发布/更新，status active**），远程端点 `https://tooloracle.io/insurance/mcp/`（streamable-http），仓库 `github.com/ToolOracle/insuranceoracle`（★0、**许可证 NOASSERTION**、2026-03-22 创建、2026-04-05 最后推送、主语言 Dockerfile——即仓库更多是**容器/清单**而非完整源码）。

**本次做了完整的 MCP 握手实测（不是只看描述）**：`initialize` 返回 `serverInfo {"name":"InsuranceOracle","version":"1.0.0"}`、协议 `2025-03-26`；`tools/list` 返回 **12 个工具**，逐个可核实：**`insurance_company`**（按名称或 **LEI 法人识别码**查欧盟保险公司，返回 **GLEIF** 注册状态/国别/地址）、**`insurance_news`**（按主题的行业新闻：solvency、life、health、property、liability、auto、reinsurance、regu…）、**`natcat_live`**（全球实时巨灾预警，来自 **GDACS**）、**`earthquake_risk`**（**USGS** 实时地震数据，可按时间/震级/位置过滤）、**`weather_risk`**（任意地点 7 日风暴/洪水/风灾风险）、**`natcat_history`**（历史巨灾统计，供风险建模）、**`solvency_check`**（**Solvency II** 合规资讯 + GLEIF 注册状态）、**`insurance_regulation`**（欧盟与德国监管动态，主题含 **bafin、eiopa、idd、gdpr、dora、ifrs17**）、**`risk_score`**（**承保用** 0–100 区位风险评分：地震＋气候＋巨灾邻近度）、**`insurance_glossary`**（用**德语或英语**解释保险与 Solvency II 术语：SCR、MCR、ORSA、SFCR、IDD、LEI、NAT CAT…）、**`claim_news`**（按事件类型的重大理赔新闻：storm/flood/earthquake/hail/fire/cyber）、**`health_check`**。**免费工具 `health_check` 的实测返回还给出了后端连通性**：`gleif` ✅、`usgs_earthquake` ✅、`gdacs_natcat` ✅、`open_meteo` ✅、`google_news_rss` ✅、`wikidata` ✅——**即它确实在实时打这些上游**（版本 1.0.0、12 个工具、端口 8501）。

**⚠️ 访问模式必须放在前面说**：实测调用计费工具 `insurance_glossary` 时，返回的是 **HTTP 402 `payment_required`**（`error_type: no_wallet`，协议 `feedoracle-402`），提示「该工具需要 API key：先在 `feedoracle.io/mcp/` 调 `kya_register`（免费、无需 API key）创建钱包并获**每月 500 个欢迎单位**，之后在请求头带 `X-API-Key`」。也就是说**它是「按量计费的商业 MCP」而非免费开放服务**（厂商 ToolOracle 自述为「自主 agent 的能力路由器」，在需要时以 **x402 / USDC on Base** 结算）。**免费额度存在，但需要注册钱包。**

对 RIAA：它的价值有两层。**① 它补的是池内一个空白——「欧盟/德国监管口径」的 MCP**：池内 MCP 已有 16 条（[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 美国监管、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[apra-mcp]] 澳洲、[[guidewire-mcp]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]] 等），但**以德国 BaFin / GDV 口径、并把 Solvency II 术语做成德英双语词条**的，此前没有；对做欧盟偿付能力（Solvency II）或德国市场研究的学生，**`insurance_glossary` 与 `insurance_regulation` 是最直接可用的两个**（相关条目：[[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[iais-icp]]）。**② 它的工具清单本身就是一份「上游数据源地图」**：工具背后的 **GLEIF（法人识别码）、GDACS（全球灾害预警）、USGS（地震）、Open-Meteo（天气）、Wikidata** 全部是**免费开放**的——**而其中 [[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]] 本 wiki 都已单独收录**，因此**即使不使用这个计费服务，读者也能顺着这份清单直接用免费上游**；`risk_score` 这类「区位承保风险评分」也可与 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[earth-engine]] 一类巨灾工具对照。

⚠️ **其余如实标注**：**①** 仓库**★0、许可证状态 NOASSERTION、主语言为 Dockerfile**，**没有可逐行审阅的完整源码**；**②** `risk_score`、`weather_risk` 的具体算法**未公开**，属**启发式评分，非可审计模型**，不应当作定价或核保依据；**③** `insurance_news`/`claim_news` 一类依赖新闻 RSS，**信息质量取决于媒体源**；**④** 计费与结算涉及加密支付通道，**读者使用前应自行了解条款与成本**；**⑤** 版本号 v1.0.0 且厂商为小型供应商，**长期可用性无保障**。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、远程端点 `initialize` 与 `tools/list`、免费工具 `health_check` 的真实返回、计费工具的 402 响应、仓库与厂商首页均经实测（HTTP 200 / 合法 JSON-RPC 响应）；**未注册钱包、未调用任何计费工具的实际数据返回**。
e.body_en:
**InsuranceOracle** is an entry in the **official MCP registry** (`registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`; `io.tooloracle/insuranceoracle`, **v1.0.0, published/updated 2026-05-07, status active**), with remote endpoint `https://tooloracle.io/insurance/mcp/` (streamable-http) and repository `github.com/ToolOracle/insuranceoracle` (**0 stars, licence NOASSERTION**, created 2026-03-22, last pushed 2026-04-05, primary language Dockerfile — i.e. the repository is a **container/manifest** rather than full source).

**A full MCP handshake was performed here (not merely reading the description)**: `initialize` returned `serverInfo {"name":"InsuranceOracle","version":"1.0.0"}` on protocol `2025-03-26`; `tools/list` returned **12 tools**, each checkable: **`insurance_company`** (look up an EU insurer by name or **LEI** legal entity identifier, returning **GLEIF** registration status, country and address), **`insurance_news`** (industry news by topic: solvency, life, health, property, liability, auto, reinsurance, regu…), **`natcat_live`** (live global catastrophe alerts from **GDACS**), **`earthquake_risk`** (**USGS** real-time earthquake data filterable by period, magnitude and location), **`weather_risk`** (7-day storm, flood and wind risk for any location), **`natcat_history`** (historical catastrophe statistics for risk modelling), **`solvency_check`** (**Solvency II** compliance news plus GLEIF registration status), **`insurance_regulation`** (EU and German regulatory updates covering **bafin, eiopa, idd, gdpr, dora, ifrs17**), **`risk_score`** (a 0–100 location risk score **for underwriting**: earthquake + weather + catastrophe proximity), **`insurance_glossary`** (explains insurance and Solvency II terms **in German or English**: SCR, MCR, ORSA, SFCR, IDD, LEI, NAT CAT…), **`claim_news`** (major claims news by event type: storm/flood/earthquake/hail/fire/cyber) and **`health_check`**. The free `health_check` call also returned **live backend connectivity**: `gleif` ✅, `usgs_earthquake` ✅, `gdacs_natcat` ✅, `open_meteo` ✅, `google_news_rss` ✅, `wikidata` ✅ — so it genuinely hits those upstreams (version 1.0.0, 12 tools, port 8501).

**⚠️ The access model belongs at the front**: calling the metered tool `insurance_glossary` returned **HTTP 402 `payment_required`** (`error_type: no_wallet`, protocol `feedoracle-402`), stating that the tool needs an API key: first call `kya_register` at `feedoracle.io/mcp/` (free, no API key needed) to create a wallet and receive **500 free units per month**, then pass the key in the `X-API-Key` header. In other words **this is a metered commercial MCP, not a free open service** (the vendor ToolOracle describes itself as a "capability router for autonomous agents", settling via **x402 / USDC on Base** where required). **A free tier exists, but a wallet registration is needed.**

For RIAA, its value is twofold. **① It fills a genuine gap: an EU/German-regulatory MCP.** The corpus already holds 16 MCP entries ([[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] for US regulation, [[insurance-ai-mcp]], [[apra-mcp]] for Australia, [[guidewire-mcp]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]] and others), but **nothing framed in German BaFin/GDV terms with Solvency II terminology as a German–English glossary**; for students working on Solvency II or the German market, **`insurance_glossary` and `insurance_regulation` are the two most directly usable tools** (related: [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-equity-risk-scr]], [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[insurance-europe]], [[iais-icp]]). **② Its tool inventory is itself a map of upstream data sources**: behind the tools sit **GLEIF (legal entity identifiers), GDACS (global disaster alerts), USGS (earthquakes), Open-Meteo (weather) and Wikidata** — all **free and open** — and **[[usgs-earthquake-api]], [[gdacs]] and [[open-meteo]] are already separately catalogued in this wiki**, so **even without using the metered service a reader can go straight to the free upstreams via this list**; scores like `risk_score` can also be compared against catastrophe tooling such as [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[openquake-engine]], [[climada]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[perils-ied]] and [[earth-engine]].

⚠️ **Other honest caveats**: **①** the repository has **0 stars, NOASSERTION licence status and Dockerfile as its primary language**, so **there is no complete source to review line by line**; **②** the algorithms behind `risk_score` and `weather_risk` are **not public** — they are **heuristic scores, not auditable models**, and must not be used as a basis for pricing or underwriting; **③** `insurance_news` and `claim_news` depend on news RSS, so **quality tracks the media sources**; **④** metering and settlement involve a crypto payment channel, so **readers should check terms and cost before use**; **⑤** at v1.0.0 from a small vendor, **long-term availability is not guaranteed**. **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the remote endpoint’s `initialize` and `tools/list`, the real return of the free `health_check` tool, the 402 response from a metered tool, the repository and the vendor home page were all measured (HTTP 200 / valid JSON-RPC responses); **no wallet was registered and no metered tool returned actual data**.
e.body_hk:
**InsuranceOracle** 是**官方 MCP registry** 上的條目（`io.tooloracle/insuranceoracle`，**v1.0.0，2026-05-07 發布/更新，status active**），遠端端點 `https://tooloracle.io/insurance/mcp/`（streamable-http），倉庫 `github.com/ToolOracle/insuranceoracle`（★0、**許可證 NOASSERTION**、2026-03-22 建立、2026-04-05 最後推送、主語言 Dockerfile——**倉庫更偏容器/清單而非完整源碼**）。

**本次做了完整 MCP 握手實測**：`initialize` 返回 `serverInfo {"name":"InsuranceOracle","version":"1.0.0"}`；`tools/list` 返回 **12 個工具**：`insurance_company`（按名稱或 **LEI 法人識別碼**查歐盟保險公司，返回 **GLEIF** 註冊狀態）、`insurance_news`、`natcat_live`（**GDACS** 全球實時巨災預警）、`earthquake_risk`（**USGS** 地震數據）、`weather_risk`（7 日風暴/洪水/風災）、`natcat_history`、`solvency_check`（**Solvency II** 合規 + GLEIF 註冊狀態）、`insurance_regulation`（歐盟與德國監管：**bafin、eiopa、idd、gdpr、dora、ifrs17**）、`risk_score`（**承保用** 0–100 區位風險評分）、`insurance_glossary`（**德/英雙語**解釋 SCR、MCR、ORSA、SFCR、IDD、LEI、NAT CAT…）、`claim_news`、`health_check`。**免費的 `health_check` 實測返回還給出後端連通性**：`gleif` ✅、`usgs_earthquake` ✅、`gdacs_natcat` ✅、`open_meteo` ✅、`google_news_rss` ✅、`wikidata` ✅。

**⚠️ 訪問模式必須先說**：實測調用計費工具 `insurance_glossary` 返回 **HTTP 402 `payment_required`**（協議 `feedoracle-402`），提示需先在 `feedoracle.io/mcp/` 調 `kya_register`（免費）建立錢包並獲**每月 500 個歡迎單位**，再以 `X-API-Key` 請求頭調用——**即它是「按量計費的商業 MCP」**（廠商自述為「自主 agent 的能力路由器」，必要時以 **x402 / USDC on Base** 結算）。**免費額度存在，但需註冊錢包。**

對 RIAA：**① 它補的是池內空白——「歐盟/德國監管口徑」的 MCP**：池內已有 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]（美國）、[[apra-mcp]]（澳洲）、[[insurance-ai-mcp]] 等，但**以德國 BaFin/GDV 口徑、並把 Solvency II 術語做成德英雙語詞條**的此前沒有（相關：[[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[iais-icp]]）；**② 它的工具清單本身就是一份上游數據源地圖**：背後的 **GLEIF、GDACS、USGS、Open-Meteo、Wikidata 全部免費開放**，而 **[[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[gdacs]]、[[open-meteo]] 本 wiki 都已單獨收錄**，**即使不用計費服務也能順著清單直用免費上游**；`risk_score` 可與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[climada]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[earth-engine]] 對照。

⚠️ **其餘如實標注**：**①** 倉庫 ★0、許可證 NOASSERTION、主語言 Dockerfile，**無可逐行審閱的完整源碼**；**②** `risk_score`／`weather_risk` 算法**未公開**，屬**啟發式評分而非可審計模型**，不應作為定價或核保依據；**③** 新聞類工具依賴 RSS，**質量取決於媒體源**；**④** 計費涉及加密支付通道，**使用前應自行了解條款與成本**；**⑤** v1.0.0 且為小型供應商，**長期可用性無保障**。**核實說明**：registry 條目、`initialize`／`tools/list`、免費工具 `health_check` 真實返回、計費工具 402 響應、倉庫與廠商首頁均經實測；**未註冊錢包、未取得任何計費工具的實際數據**。
